# T-3: Bind repair evidence

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
repair evidence の fingerprint、reviewed tree、repair diff、validating test result を current finding と evaluated target state に個別比較し、不一致 evidence を gate が受理しないようにする。

## Acceptance Criteria
- Accepted evidence matches fingerprint, reviewed tree, repair diff, and validating test result.
- Unrelated, stale, touched-only, or mismatched evidence leaves the mandatory gate block in place.

## Implementation Notes
RepairEvidenceReference、RepairReference、IssueLogRepairEvidenceSource、FindingDispositionPolicy.evaluateGate() の typed contract を変更し、current invariants を class boundary で fail closed にする。

## Test Strategy
unit/spec-local tests cover four-value equality acceptance and each evidence mismatch category through evaluateGate().
